en.text: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

zhSimplified.text: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。

zhTraditional.text: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。

en.text: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

footnotes.text: 1:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 他说：耶和华啊！我呼求你， 你不应允，要到几时呢？ 我因强暴哀求你，你还不拯救。

zhTraditional.text: 他說：耶和華啊！我呼求你， 你不應允，要到幾時呢？ 我因強暴哀求你，你還不拯救。

en.text: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

zhSimplified.text: 你为何使我看见罪孽？ 你为何看着奸恶而不理呢？ 毁灭和强暴在我面前， 又起了争端和相斗的事。

zhTraditional.text: 你為何使我看見罪孽？ 你為何看着奸惡而不理呢？ 毀滅和強暴在我面前， 又起了爭端和相鬥的事。

en.text: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.

zhSimplified.text: 因此律法放松， 公理也不显明； 恶人围困义人， 所以公理显然颠倒。

zhTraditional.text: 因此律法放鬆， 公理也不顯明； 惡人圍困義人， 所以公理顯然顛倒。

en.text: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说：你们要向列国中观看， 大大惊奇； 因为在你们的时候，我行一件事， 虽有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說：你們要向列國中觀看， 大大驚奇； 因為在你們的時候，我行一件事， 雖有人告訴你們，你們總是不信。

en.text: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

footnotes.text: 1:6 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 我必兴起迦勒底人， 就是那残忍暴躁之民，通行遍地， 占据那不属自己的住处。

zhTraditional.text: 我必興起迦勒底人， 就是那殘忍暴躁之民，通行遍地， 佔據那不屬自己的住處。

en.text: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 他威武可畏， 判断和势力都任意发出。

zhTraditional.text: 他威武可畏， 判斷和勢力都任意發出。

en.text: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

zhSimplified.text: 他的马比豹更快， 比晚上的豺狼更猛。 马兵踊跃争先， 都从远方而来； 他们飞跑如鹰抓食，

zhTraditional.text: 他的馬比豹更快， 比晚上的豺狼更猛。 馬兵踴躍爭先， 都從遠方而來； 他們飛跑如鷹抓食，

en.text: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.

zhSimplified.text: 都为行强暴而来， 定住脸面向前， 将掳掠的人聚集，多如尘沙。

zhTraditional.text: 都為行強暴而來， 定住臉面向前， 將擄掠的人聚集，多如塵沙。

en.text: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

zhSimplified.text: 他们讥诮君王，笑话首领， 嗤笑一切保障，筑垒攻取。

zhTraditional.text: 他們譏誚君王，笑話首領， 嗤笑一切保障，築壘攻取。

en.text: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”

zhSimplified.text: 他以自己的势力为神， 像风猛然扫过，显为有罪。

zhTraditional.text: 他以自己的勢力為神， 像風猛然掃過，顯為有罪。

en.text: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的 神，我的圣者啊， 你不是从亘古而有吗？ 我们必不致死。 耶和华啊，你派定他为要刑罚人； 磐石啊，你设立他为要惩治人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的上帝，我的聖者啊， 你不是從亙古而有嗎？ 我們必不致死。 耶和華啊，你派定他為要刑罰人； 磐石啊，你設立他為要懲治人。

en.text: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

zhSimplified.text: 你眼目清洁， 不看邪僻，不看奸恶； 行诡诈的，你为何看着不理呢？ 恶人吞灭比自己公义的， 你为何静默不语呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你眼目清潔， 不看邪僻，不看奸惡； 行詭詐的，你為何看着不理呢？ 惡人吞滅比自己公義的， 你為何靜默不語呢？

en.text: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?

zhSimplified.text: 你为何使人如海中的鱼， 又如没有管辖的爬物呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你為何使人如海中的魚， 又如沒有管轄的爬物呢？

en.text: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

zhSimplified.text: 他用钩钩住，用网捕获， 用拉网聚集他们； 因此，他欢喜快乐，

zhTraditional.text: 他用鉤鉤住，用網捕獲， 用拉網聚集他們； 因此，他歡喜快樂，

en.text: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.

zhSimplified.text: 就向网献祭，向网烧香， 因他由此得肥美的分和富裕的食物。

zhTraditional.text: 就向網獻祭，向網燒香， 因他由此得肥美的分和富裕的食物。

en.text: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?

zhSimplified.text: 他岂可屡次倒空网罗， 将列国的人时常杀戮，毫不顾惜呢？

zhTraditional.text: 他豈可屢次倒空網羅， 將列國的人時常殺戮，毫不顧惜呢？
